tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the default: the brand lives after dark. Paper is a near-white for daylight play outdoors, print and long reading.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets that sit on ground (case brief, team roster).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, anything one step above surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (ghost button, input). Meets 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels. 4.5:1+ on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: THE red thread: a vivid signal red, the one accent. The thread line, the primary button fill, pins on ground. 4.5:1 on Paper ground, 4.1:1 on Night ground (graphics and text 24px+ there). Small red text uses thread-text; on manila use manila-thread (thread is 2.9:1 there).

tokens.name: thread-text
tokens.usage: Red text and red mono labels (open-case tags, inline emphasis). 6:1+ on Night ground and surface, 5.9:1 on Paper ground.

tokens.name: thread-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of thread fills. Text on it is on-thread.

tokens.name: on-thread
tokens.usage: Text and icons on thread or thread-deep fills (4.7:1 on thread, 8:1 on thread-deep). Keep button labels 15px medium or larger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: manila
tokens.usage: Evidence paper: evidence cards, case-file folders. The same in both themes, like a real object on the table. On Paper ground it's only 1.6:1, so always give it shadow-card.

tokens.name: manila-ink
tokens.usage: Text on manila (10:1).

tokens.name: manila-thread
tokens.usage: Red text, stamps and pins on manila (5.6:1). Replaces thread and brass on manila.

tokens.name: manila-line
tokens.usage: Dashed tear lines and rules on manila. Decorative.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Pins on ground, evidence tags, case numbers. A supporting metal, never a second accent or a button. Text-safe on ground and surface in both themes. Not on manila (1.7:1 on Night).

tokens.name: solved
tokens.usage: Correct answer / case closed. Lighter than thread on Night and darker on Paper, so it never relies on hue alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Posters, the landing hero, case titles on the start screen.

styles.name: heading-italic
styles.usage: One phrase of emphasis inside a serif headline. Never a whole line.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Instructions, card titles in the app, button-adjacent headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The guard swears the gate was locked at 11:40. The CCTV says otherwise.
styles.usage: Evidence text, case briefs, everything read on the street.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase file labels: case numbers, tags, timestamps, coordinates.

styles.name: evidence
styles.usage: Times, coordinates, transcripts and anything that should feel like a record.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; phone screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room; poster margins.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, full-bleed blocks, posters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, tags. Paper has barely-rounded corners; nothing here is soft.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pins and knots only (discs). Never for buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Evidence on the table: evidence cards and folders only.

tokens.name: thread-width
tokens.usage: The thread line in UI: dividers, the wordmark, connections between pieces of evidence.

tokens.name: thread-width-hero
tokens.usage: The thread at poster and hero scale.
